ambiguities_or_notes: The French original and following Soviet Russian rendering are translated separately and intentionally duplicate the same letter.

couru le monde is rendered went about in society in the direct French translation; the Russian rendering’s бывал в свете becomes went about in society as well without adding stronger dissipation language.
suites de mon entrevue is rendered what came of my meeting; the deliberately anticlimactic list of health, theater, and flowers is retained.
The envelope address to Chern in Tula province and all six duplicated explanatory notes are represented.
The source heading says end of February while the editorial note cites Yergolskaya’s envelope notation 1 March 1851; the inherited February range is retained without inventing a precise day.
